doc.title: Functions
doc.para: Functions In TJS2, functions are almost synonymous with subroutines. Even cases that do not return a value are treated as functions. Additionally, functions that are members of a class or object in particular are sometimes called "methods".

In-expression Functions By using the function keyword within an expression, you can create unnamed functions, in-expression functions (anonymous functions). In this case, the function name is omitted.
var func = function(i) { return i*5; }; var func2 = function { System.inform("hoge"); }; var v = func(); // Call func func2(); // Call func2
